title: How to install or update the anvil binary after a build (Windows)
what:
To install, update or deploy a new anvil binary:
1. Run `cargo build --release -p anvil-cli`.
2. Rename the running ~/.cargo/bin/anvil.exe; Windows allows renaming a running executable but not overwriting it.
3. Copy target/release/anvil.exe into ~/.cargo/bin.
4. Delete the renamed copy.
5. Run `anvil sync` so agent and skill templates embedded in the binary are refreshed in .claude/.
why: The anvil MCP server keeps the old executable locked; cargo install fails on Windows and stale templates stay until a sync.
learned: Claude Code hot-reloads new agent files, but edits to an existing agent file may not reload in a running session; restart it to pick them up.
author: reactive-end
